batting.name: J Arunkumar
batting.dismissal: c SK Trivedi b Sohail Tanvir

batting.name: Misbah-ul-Haq
batting.dismissal: c T Kohli b MM Patel

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b SK Trivedi

batting.name: CL White
batting.dismissal: c SK Trivedi b MM Patel

batting.name: DT Patil
batting.dismissal: c RA Jadeja b SK Warne

batting.name: P Kumar
batting.dismissal: c M Kaif b SK Warne

batting.name: A Kumble
batting.dismissal: c M Rawat b Sohail Tanvir

balls.text: another full ball on leg and middle, Watson leans forward and flicks the ball to deep midwicket for two more to end the innings, 11 runs off the over
short of a length delivery skids into Watson who mis-times the pull towards deep midwicket for two more
dropped, miserable fielding, Watson clips a full length ball off his pads towards deep square leg where Vinay Kumar drops a sitter of a catch, Bangalore are in shambles
another full ball on leg and middle, Watson digs it out towards deep square leg for two more

Watson backs away towards the leg side but Praveen follows him and bowls a full ball that hits Watson on the boot and runs towards fine leg, Watson runs the first quickly and sprints back for the second
full ball angling into the left hander, Smith makes room and drives towards wide long-on
Smith backs away towards leg and Zaheer follows him, Smith gets an edge on leg side
Smith backs away towards leg and drives a low full toss from middle stump towards long on where Kohli cuts off the boudnary
fuller length on middle stump, Watson swings the ball through square leg for the single
that's a short ball on leg stump, asking for punishment when fine leg is in the circle, Watson moves across and pulls to the long leg boundary
fuller length angling into the left-hander, Smith tries to swing the ball through square leg but mis-times it towards short fine leg
Smith charges Zaheer once again and tries to pull the short ball, he misses it this time, Zaheer saw him coming and responded well
Smith backs away to a full ball outside off stump and throws his bat at it, he keeps the strike with a single towards point
Watson swings across the line and collects a single to deep midwicket
Smith hits another full toss flat and hard towards mid-off where White dives forward but can't quite reach the ball to take the catch

Smith smiles at Kallis after the edge but Kallis won't be seeing the funny side of it, Smith charged at a full toss outside off and swung across the line, the outside edge ran between the keeper and short third man for four
Watson moves forward and swats another full toss towards cover for one more
Watson moves forward and across to a low full toss and chips the ball towards square leg
Smith charges down the track, Zaheer bowls the short ball but this time Smith pulls hard and hits the ball flat towards deep midwicket, the ball bounces once before going over the boundary
driven towards long-on for two more, excellent running
Smith slashes at a fuller and wider ball and hits the ball towards deep backward point where Razzak attempts to field by running his his right but can't stop the boudnary
nothing is going Bangalore's way, Watson moves back and tries to turn a good length ball off his pads but gets a leading edge that falls safely in the mid-off region
Watson slashes at a full toss outside off and gets an outside edge that runs between the keeper and short third man for four more

bizarre effort, or a non-effort, Smith backs away towards the leg side, Zaheer follows him with a full ball and smith lofts the ball towards deep midwicket, the ball is in the air for quite a while but Praveen Kumar makes no effort to catch it, did he lose it in the background? Dravid and Zaheer are rather upset
a low full toss outside off stump, Smith makes room and smashes the ball towards long off where Misbah does the fielding
Smith digs the ball out from the block hole and plays it back to Kallis
flicked off the pads through midwicket

dropped and four! Watson lofts a full ball angling into him towards long-on where Misbah runs to his left and dives, he got his hands to a difficult catch - it was low - but couldn't hold on, the ball beats him and goes for four
Smith moves towards the leg side and slogs a good length ball from middle and off stump towards long-on, not a very elegant shot but Smith isn't a very elegant batsman
Watson mis-times a full toss outside off stump towards cover, he could have done more with that

Smith ends Kumble's spell in style, he backs away towards leg to make room and makes use of the short length to free his arms and pull the ball on to the roof at deep midwicket, he's got to 50 with that six
Watson hits a low full toss off the front foot towards midwicket
Smith moves a long way towards the leg side before Kumble releases the ball, he mis-hits the drive towards long-on when he was looking to hit on the off side
driven off the front foot towards long-on for a single
a bit too short and Watson pulls the ball towards the gap on the deep midwicket boundary, Watson's hit it so powerfully
Watson gets into position and tees off, smashing a full ball from  off stump with a straight bat, long on had no chance
and Razzak's comeback over gets ruined further, Smith slogs across the line and hits the ball behind square leg for four more
that's a shocking wide outside off stump, Patil moves towards the ball and he should have stopped it but the ball goes under him and runs to the boudnary
Watson mis-times the pull towards midwicket and hurtles through for the single, excellent running
flat and fast on off stump, punched off the back foot towards cover

too short and Watson moves quickly on to the back foot and pulls towards wide long-on where Misbah makes a diving save, the ball nearly goes over the rope after he fails to collect cleanly but Misbah recovers in time to stop it again
Watson moves back to another quick delivery on middle and defends on the off side
bowled flat and straight, Watson defends off the back foot towards cover
that's a bit short again and Watson swivels and pulls towards deep square leg for the single
flicked off the front foot towards midwicket
that's too short, Watson is quick to move back in his crease and pull the ball through the gap between deep midwicket and long on, powerful shot
he comes out of his crease and defends a good length ball back to the bowler with a perfectly straight bat

Kumble picks up his first wicket of the tournament! Asnodkar tries to cut a good length ball through the off side but gets an outside edge that flies towards short third man where Misbah holds a simple catch
Asnodkar heaves powerfully across the line and gets an inside edge on to his pad
Smith clears his front foot out of the way to make room and slog-sweeps the ball towards deep midwicket, he hasn't timed it all that well so the fielder gets to it on the bounce
Asnodkar moves forward and drives the ball through cover for a single to reach 50, well played, he's had a lot of luck but he's made it count
full toss outside off stump, Asnodkar slashes hard at it and places the ball past the fielder at backward point for four
Asnodkar moves his front foot out of the way and once again slogs across the line, he was too early on the shot for it was a slower ball from Kohli
Smith makes room by moving towards the leg side but Kohli fires the ball into the blockhole, Smith digs it out past the bowler
bowled full angling into off and middle stump, Asnodkar drives towards the fielder on the sweeper boundary
turned off the pads for a single, this is the fourth 100-run stand for the 1st wicket in the tournament, and the second by Rajasthan, the first was between Smith and  Yusuf Pathan
Kumble pitches just short of a length outside off, Asnodkar moves back and cuts hard, he gets more of a thick outside edge past the fielder at short third man for four more
Asnodkar moves his front foot out of the way and heaves across the line, he misses and is nearly bowled
pushed off the front foot towards the bowler
cut off the back foot towards point

another mis-hits falls safe, Smith comes down the track and tries to loft Kumble out of the ground, he mis-times it towards long-off but the ball falls short of the fielder, Kumble's yet to take a wicket in the tournament
Smith tries to slog across the line of a delivery that is angling across him from over the wicket, he gets an outside edge that runs down to third man
Asnodkar tries to work the ball from leg stump behidn square but mis-hits it towards midwicket
Smith moves towards leg to make room and drives a good length ball from off stump through cover point for a single
the slower delivery bowled full on middle and leg, Asnodkar uses the angle into him to turn the ball off his pads towards short fine leg
that's wide down leg side, the keeper fails to collect but it will be just the single
full ball angling into off stump, Asnodkar plays t6he ball late behind point for one more
full ball on middle and off, Smith backs away towards leg and uses the room to drive towards long off
a quick full toss outside off stump, Smith gets on to the front foot and drives towards long off
bowled slower through the air on middle and off, Asnodkar comes on to the front foot and drives towards extra cover
bowled full on off stump, Smith leans forward and drives firmly towards long-off for a single
pushed towards the off side for a single
tight line and length on off stump, Asnodkar comes forward and tries to drive but plays it back to the bowler
drifts on to leg stump, Asnodkar tries to work the ball off his pads and places the ball fine past the wicketkeeper
fired in flat and straight to the right-hander, Asnodkar moves back and works the ball off his pads behind square
driven to long-on for a single

Smith moves across his stumps to create the angle to sweep and connects well, the ball runs towards fine leg and Zaheer runs to his left and tries to stop the ball with his boot, his football skills evidently aren't all that flash
defended on the front foot towards the leg side
bowled flat and fast on off and middle, Smith defends to the bowler

welcome to the IPL Razzak! Smith moves towards the leg side to make room and swings his bat hard to loft the ball on to the roof of the stands at deep midwicket, massive hit, Razzak's conceded 11 runs off one ball!
he starts off with a no-ball, Smith leans forward to drive and gets an outside edge that runs to the third-man boundary, free hit coming up
short and wide outside off stump, Asnodkar stands in his crease and cuts the ball hard and high over point, that's an excellent shot, much better than some of the others he's played
Asnodkar tries to drive a good length ball straight down the ground but mis-times the shot to mid-on
short and wide down leg side, Asnodkar tries to hook but the ball is out of his reach, it's too far from Patil as well and Rajasthan's total ticks over by five wides
excellent ball, Smith digs out the yorker from middle stump towards mid-off for a single, he's been quiet today has Smith, just looking to give Asnodkar the strike
short of a length on off stump, Smith backs away and tries to cut, he hits it well but can't beat the fielder at point
fuller length outside off stump, Asnodkar waits for it in his crease and drives towards cover
Smith moves back to a good length delivery and steers the ball towards third man

Smith leans forward and drives a full toss firmly back at Praveen who bends down on his follow through and sticks his left hand out to field it, he gets a hand to it and the batsmen run a single on the re-bound towards mid-on
good length delivery on leg and middle, Asnodkar works the ball off his pads behind square to bring up the 50 partnership
fuller length outside off stump, Asnodkar stands in his crease and lofts the slower ball high over cover, he clears the in-field comfortably and the ball bounces towards the boundary
banged in short outside off stump, that really lifts on Asnodkar who tries to play the upper cut but gets beaten, that's the one bouncer for the over
that's a bit too short on middle and leg, Asnodkar swivels and pulls the ball towards long leg for two
Asnodkar moves back and works the ball off his pads towards midwicket
this time Asnodkar plays a controlled cut towards third man for a single to end the over
unbelievable, Asnodkar should buy a lottery ticket, he slashes outside off stump once again and gets a thick outside edge that flies high but between first slip and the wicketkeeper for four
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Asnodkar jumps on to the back foot and tries to cut but misses, he was perhaps trying to hit it a bit too hard
Asnodkar tries to cut a delivery that pitches around off and angles into the right-hander, there's no room for the shot and Asnodkar  gets beaten

Rajasthan's luck continues! Asnodkar tries to pull a short ball but is in no position to play that shot, he gets a top edge that flies right over the wicketkeeper for four, they've been really lucky today
he starts with an offcutter that cramps Asnodkar for room, he tries to cut but gets a bottom edge on the off side
Praveen strays down leg side and Asnodkar tries to swivels and play the ball past short fine leg, he fails to make proper contact
good length delivery on off stump, Smith pushes the ball towards point and sprints the single
Praveen bowls the bouncer, Smith begins to play the pull but decides to let the ball go, that ball was too high and the umpire calls it wide
he pitches on a good length outside off and angles the ball into Smith who strides forward and defends towards point
good length delivery closer to off stump, Asnodkar guides the ball towards Kumble at third man
short of a length delivery outside off stump, the ball seams away from Asnodkar who cuts and misses, Patil once again fumbles and parries the ball to first slip
driven powerfully off the front foot towards cover point
this time the length is a bit short and the line too wide, Smith slashes and places the ball fine towards third man for four more

how lucky is Smith? He charges down the track at Zaheer but he comes down too early, Zaheer sees him coming and bowls a short ball angled at the body, Smith tries to fend it away and gets caught in an awkward position, the ball hits the top edge and flies over the wicketkeeper for four
Smith looks to drive a good length delivery through the off side but gets an inside edge that goes through the gap at midwicket

lovely ball, Zaheer angles the ball into the left-hander and draws Smith on to the front foot with his good length, the ball seams away from Smith off the pitch and beats the outside edge of Smith's forward  push

Asnodkar gets cramped for room by a good length ball that jags back into him from outside off, he defends the ball towards point and sets off for the single, there's a direct hit at the batsman's end but Smith is safe
good length delivery outside off stump, Smith taps the ball in front of point and calls Asnodkar through for the single
pitches on a good length outside off stump and seams away from Asnodkar who slashes at the ball but misses

massive appeal for lbw and Praveen can't believe it hasn't been given! Asnodkar tries to swing a good length ball from middle stump towards midwicket and misses, he gets hit on the pad in front of middle and leg, that would have hit leg stump, was there an inside edge though?
that's intentional! The length is short and wide outside off stump and Asnodkar stays on the back foot and cuts the ball past the fielder at first slip for four, he controlled that superbly
that's wide down leg side, Patil dives to his right but can't collect, the ball runs towards fine leg where Kumble dives and saves the boundary

Smith moves forward and tries to work the ball through the leg side by closing the face of the bat but gets a leading edge towards the off side, there are just two fielders in front of square on the leg side
good length delivery pitches outside off stump and skids the ball away from Smith who pushes the ball towards Kohli at point
a bit too straight on middle and leg, Smith moves across and pushes the ball off his pads towards square leg
he's packed a punch! The length is too short and Asnodkar swivels and pulls off the front foot, he's connected splendidly and the ball clears deep midwicket, he's quite the dynamo this Asnodkar
Zaheer pitches outside off stump and slants the ball further away from the right-hander, Asnodkar chases and tries to smash the ball over cover but misses
Smith strides on to the front foot and gets an inside edge towards the leg side while trying to defend
Zaheer pitches on a good length around off and nips the ball back into Asnodkar who waits on the back foot and guides the ball towards backward point
Zaheer fails to adjust the line to the right-hander and fires the ball down leg side, it was the shorter ball as well, Patil dives athletically to his left and saves runs
excellent ball, pitches short of a length around off stump and seams away from Smith who stands on the back foot and gets beaten while trying to defend, the keeper fumbles and the batsmen run a bye
Zaheer starts with a good length delivery slightly wide outside off stump, the ball seams away from the left-hander and Smith lets it go

Dravid ends the match with a six, valiant but futile, he jumps down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it straight over the bowler's head for six more, he finishes with 75 off 36 balls and has shown his team-mates up

Dravid charges and tries to loft down the ground, he gets an inside edge and the ball runs towards the fine leg boundary where Tanvir makes one of the worst attempts to field the ball that I have ever seen
driven towards cover and again he doesn't take the single
Dravid clears his front foot out of the way and lofts the ball to long on and once again refuses the single
Dravid gets down on one knee and pulls towards deep midwicket, he refuses the single
Dravid goes inside out and lofts the ball over extra cover for four more

caught! It's all over, or perhaps it isn't. Razzak tries to slog the ball down the ground and hits the ball flat and hard towards mid-on where Trivedi dives forward to take a low catch, it's a low catch and Razzak stands his ground because he is unsure whether Tribedi caught it, Bowden asks for the third umpire and we're now looking at replays ... it's been given not out, low catches referred to the third umpire are rarely given out.
Tanvir fires in the yorker on off and middle stump, Razzak defends and gets an inside edge on to the pad
caught! Tanvir pitches the ball short of a length and gets it to lift sharply into Kumble who tries to run the ball to third man, but only manages a nick through to Rawat who takes an easy catch
Dravid drives the ball through covers for  a single
Dravid makes room by moving towards leg and lofts inside out over extra cover, Watson fields on the boundary
Kumble plays the ball awkwardly towards long-off, he was beaten by the slower one
Dravid tries to play the paddle sweep but misses and gets hit on the pad
Dravid makes room by moving his front foot out of the way and slogs the ball into the gap at deep midwicket, he's playing some innings here, partly out of anger and frustration I suspect
driven off the front foot towards long-off for one more
Dravid tries to cut through point but the ball is too close to him and he gets an edge to short third man
Kumble cuts off the back foot towards deep point
fired into the block hole,  Kumble digs it out on the off side

that's the third one on the roof! Dravid charges Yusuf and lofts him cleanly through the line over deep midwicket, he brings up his 50 with that shot, 53 off 25 balls, Dravid is showing up his team-mates here, he could have done with a lot more support
he's hit another one on to the roof, Dravid clears his front foot out of the way against and slog-sweeps the ball with the spin over deep square leg, massive hit
Dravid tries to play the cheeky reverse sweep against the spin but gets cramped for room

Dravid's being the boy on the burning deck here, he clears his front foot out of the way and swings a full ball from middle and leg over deep midwicket, that's gone on to the roof, someone's climbed up to try and retrieve it
Dravid tries to pull another faster ball but gets beaten
Dravid moves back and defends a quicker ball towards the leg side
Kumble charges Warne and throws his bat at the ball, trying to hit over cover, he gets an outside edge that runs to the third man boundary
cut off the back foot through point
driven through covers for one
Warne pitches on leg stump and rips the legbreak across Kumble's front foot defense

Warne's pulled off a stunner! Zaheer hammers the ball straight and hard right back at Warne, the ball flies low towards Warne's right, he bends down low and stretches out his right hand to take a one-handed catch inches off the ground, the ball was nearly past him when he took the catch, stunning, simply stunning, he is now the highest wicket-taker in the IPL
defended on the front foot towards the leg side, well and attempted defence really, the ball hit the pad
Dravid moves on to the back foot and opens the face of the bat to guide the ball towards third man, he gets two but won't keep the strike
that's a massive six! Dravid gets under a flat and fast delivery and lofts the ball sweetly over deep midwicket, that has gone several rows back
Zaheer moves back and nudges a quicker ball awkwardly towards square leg
defended on the back foot towards the leg side
Dravid moves back and pulls the ball awkwardly towards deep midwicket, that was in the air but it fell safe
Dravid tries to cut off the back foot but misses
tossed up on middle stump, it's the legbreak and Zaheer strides forward to defend

and he goes first ball! He steps out of his crease and tries to clear long-off, he's hit it pretty well but not well enough, the ball goes high in the air and Kaif takes a well-judged catch a few feet inside the long-off boundary, Dravid watches helplessly from the other end
caught! Patil tries to loft Warne out of the ground, the ball is quicker and flatter and  he mis-hits it straight to Jadeja at long-on
Dravid moves deep in his crease and drives the ball through cover
bowled flat outside off stump, Patil cuts off the back foot towards point where a fumble allows the single
that's a bit ambitious, Patil tries to reverse sweep Warne and mis-hits it past the fielder at short third man
Patil moves across his stumps and pushes a slower ball towards square leg
bowled full and fast on middle stump, Dravid tries to drive but gets an inside edge through square leg
Trivedi strays down leg side and Dravid helps the slower ball towards fine leg for four more with a deft leg glance
short of a length delivery on the stumps, Patil backs away towards leg and drives towards cover
too full down leg side, that's a wide and Bowden agrees
too full on the pads this time, Dravid glances the ball off his legs towards the fine leg boudnary

banged in short and Dravid gets on to the front foot and pulls the ball with a lot of power towards deep midwicket, there's a fielder on the fence but the ball beats Yusuf and goes over the boundary, that's the first six of the innings
Patil backs away towards leg and mis-times the drive towards cover
Patil slogs across the line and mis-times the ball through square leg, Patil sprints back for the second
bowled quicker through the air on middle and leg stump, defended on the back foot towards the bowler
cut off the back foot through point
Dravid steps out of his crease and flicks a flighted delivery through the gap at midwicket for four
Patil gets down on one knee and sweeps Warne from middle stump towards deep backward square leg
Patil moves across his stumps and nudges the ball off his pads behind square
good length delivery angling into off stump, Patil moves back and across and defends back to the bowler
short of a length on off stump, the batsman jumps on to the back foot and defends
fuller ball on middle and leg, flicked off the pads through the leg side

caught! Kallis backs away towards leg to make room, Trivedi follows him with a short of a length ball, Kallis gets cramped for room while playing the pull and lofts it to Yusuf Pathan at deep midwicket, simple catch
starts off with a slower ball, Kallis makes room and drives through cover for a single
Kallis charges Warne once again and lofts straight down the ground, the fielder at long on runs to his right and prevents the boundary
cut off the back foot towards point for one
dropped in theory at least, Kallis drives a flighted ball hard and towards Warne's right, he sticks his hand out but can't hold on, that was hit very hard
Kallis steps out of his crease, realises he's beaten by the length and defends
Dravid moves across his stumps, gets down on one knee and sweeps towards deep backward  square leg
tossed up on off stump, Kallis drives off the front foot towards point
driven off the front foot towards long-on for a single

was that an edge? Rawat thought so, Kallis slashes at a wide ball outside off and there is a sound as the ball passed the bat, Rawat appeals immediately but Watson's shout is late, the umpire says not out
banged in short by Watson, Dravid tries to hook but gets a top edge that falls safely at square leg
the length isn't short enough to pull and Dravid moves on to the back foot and mis-hits the pull to midwicket
good length delivery angling into the right-hander, Dravid defends towards point off the back foot
Wastons bowls the yorker first up which Dravid plays to mid-on

woeful, woeful batting from Bangalore, White moves forward and across his stumps and plays a nothing shot, he merely chipped the ball with absolutely no power and it landed in Trivedi's hands at a deepish mid-on
driven down the ground off the front foot for a single, they've hit only three boundaries in eight overs
White leans forward and tries to play a full ball from outside off stump through the leg side by closing the face, he gets a leading edge that falls short of the fielder running in from deep cover
Kallis moves forward and outside the line of off stump and tries to flick, he mis-hits it towards the leg side
White moves out of his crease and works a good length ball from middle stump towards fine leg, just the single, Bangalore haven't hit a six yet, they need several sixes
good length delivery on off and middle, defended on the leg side off the front foot
White moves out of his crease and nudges a good length ball off his pads towards square leg
Kallis drives the ball elegantly through the covers but will get only a single
Kallis begins to come forward but gets caught on the move by a short of a length delivery that thuds into his bat
short of a length over middle and leg stump, Kallis moves a long way across and tries to play the leg glance but misses, Bowden has a good look at it and decides it isn't wide, good call
banged in short, too short, and Bowden signals a wide for height
good length once again angling into off stump, White drops the ball behind point with an open face and scampers the single
good length delivery just outside off stump, defended on the off side off the front foot
Kallis steps out of his crease and slashes at a short of a length ball, he hits the ball over cover point and will get four for it, Bangalore have scored only 23 off the Powerplays
excellent bowling, Munaf hits a tight length around off stump, Kallis moves forward and can only defend back to the bowler
short of a length delivery pitches in line with the stumps, Kallis backs away and tries to drive through the off side but misses
Kallis moves forward and across his stumps and plays a good length delivery towards midwicket
Kallis gets behind the line of a good length ball and defends towards the bowler
good length ball angling into off and middle, White moves forward and pushes the ball towards mid-on for a single
White moves on the the back foot and opens the face of the bat to guide a ball that cuts back into him off the pitch towards third man
White begins to come forward but gets beaten by a slower ball that nips back into him, that cut him in half
short of a length outside off stump, Kallis frees his arms and cuts towards third man
banged in short down leg side, Kallis tries to hook but misses, Rajasthan appeals but Bowden signals wide
fuller length on middle stump, Kallis moves forward and nudges the ball towards midwicket, White was backing up a bit too far and had to dive to make his ground and beat Asnodkar's throw
good length delivery pitches in line with the stumps and slants across Kallis who waits in his crease and pushes the ball towards the off side
tight line and length around off stump, defended on the front foot
good length delivery on off and middle, White comes on to the front foot and defends
excellent shot! The length is a bit too full outside off, White leans on to the front foot and punches the ball between cover and mid-off for four
a bit too straight from Munaf and Kallis works the ball off his hips behind square for a single
fuller length outside off stump, Kallis moves outside the line of off stump and plays the ball back to the bowler, he was looking to flick through the leg side
short of a length on off stump, Kallis gets behind the line on the back foot and defends
good length on middle and leg stump, Kallis moves forward and across and flicks the ball crisply off his pads through midwicket for the first boundary off the innings
full ball on leg and middle stump, defended off the front foot towards the leg side
short of a length outside off stump, inviting White to come and get it, he lets it go through to the keeper
this time Tanvir bowls the ball to far outside off from over the wicket, Bowden signals wide in his own curious way
short of a length delivery pitches outside off and slants across the right-hander, White lets it go through to the keeper
he gets a yorker first up which he plays towards midwicket
bowled him! Kohli tries to cut a delivery that angles across him from over the wicket, he doesn't have the room and bottom edges the ball on to his stumps, Bangalore look listless
banged in short by Tanvir, the batsman ducks under it
full ball down leg side, that's the first extra of the innings
tight line and length on off stump, Kallis moves on to the front foot and defends on the off side
Kohli moves across his stumps and drops the ball with soft hands on the pitch, Kallis calls him through for the single
Kallis leans forward and works a straighter ball off his pads through square leg to get off the mark
good length delivery on middle and off stump, Kallis moves forward and defends towards point

Bangalore sink further! Misbah tries to pull Munaf but the length isn't short enough, the ball comes to him a bit too quickly and he mis-hits it straight to mid-on where the substitute Taruwar Kohli takes a sitter
good length delivery on off stump, Kohli moves back and opens the face to run the ball towards third man
Kolhi leans forward to a good length ball and closes the face to push the ball towards mid-on
short and wide outside off stump, Kohli throws his bat at it but misses the cut
full ball angling across the right-hander, Kohli drives off the front foot and gets beaten
caught! Bangalore make an awful start, Arunkumar tries to loft Tanvir down the ground but only succeeds in skying the ball high in the air towards mid-off where Trivedi takes the catch
Tanvir gets the ball to rise from a good length and angle across the right-hander, Arunkumar tries to cut but gets  beaten
short of a length outside off stump, Arunkumar cuts off the front foot towards point
